text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reporter Otonashi interviews me in preparation for the URA Finale.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While the conversation gets a little intense at times, I wrap it up by declaring that I will do everything I can to help <chrname> shine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she still doesn't have enough fans to qualify as a star Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time to pull out all the stops.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've been steadily gathering fans, and she's on track to becoming a star Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Resolving to keep up our momentum, I ready myself for the next challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're off to a great start, and it shows in the number of fans supporting us. She's already well on her way to becoming a star Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm determined to keep up the impressive pace we've set.
